the-arnolfini-portrait.title: The mirror.
the-arnolfini-portrait.note: Look at the round mirror on the back wall. Two more people are standing in the doorway.

the-arnolfini-portrait.title: One candle.
the-arnolfini-portrait.note: A single candle burns in the chandelier in broad daylight.

the-arnolfini-portrait.title: The little dog.
the-arnolfini-portrait.note: A small dog waits at their feet, painted almost hair by hair.

hunters-in-the-snow.title: The hunters.
hunters-in-the-snow.note: Heads down, they bring home one fox between them.

hunters-in-the-snow.title: The skaters.
hunters-in-the-snow.note: The whole village is out on the frozen ponds.

hunters-in-the-snow.title: The inn sign.
hunters-in-the-snow.note: It hangs from a single hinge, about to fall.

lifeStops.text: Born in a village in the south of the Netherlands.
Decides, at 27, to become a painter.
Moves to Paris and discovers bright colour.
Arles, the yellow house and the sunflowers.
In a hospital in the south of France, he paints The Starry Night.
Dies in a village outside Paris, aged 37.

vincent-van-gogh.quote: It often seems to me that the night is still more richly coloured than the day.

rachel-ruysch.spotlightLine: She painted flowers for almost seventy years and was one of the best paid painters of her day.
